div.head: Hn 8.1
div.ab: Speciali tamen plenitudine si opus est, bis in anno conueniant in hundretum suum quicunque liberi, tam hurðefest quam folgarii, ad dinoscendum scilicet inter cetera, si decanie plene sint, uel qui, quomodo, qua ratione recesserint, uel (qui) superacreuerint.

note.label: refers to / echoes
note.quote: the Leges/Quadripartitus author can only be referring to Cnut's law (16) – as anyway suggested by hurðefest … folgarii and other echoes
